8.en: Inquisitor Lord Hieronymo Drake is dead. Before the veil of the Noctis Aeterna lifted from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.lpu6iuTHw50UavbI]{Belnshudha}, cut off from the rest of the sector, Drake and his forces fought on the planet’s surface. To his horror, the Inquisitor realised he had underestimated the enemy’s strength. Where Drake expected an entrenched cult, he found a company of heretic Astartes anointing a Noctilith Crown with the blood of fools who had rallied to their heretical banner. The foul traitors called forth endless scores of daemons from the Warp, threatening to provide the Ruinous Powers with a foothold at the heart of the sector. Ultimately, the Inquisitor Lord had no choice but to order an

12.en: of the planet while remaining trapped on the surface. Without their sacrifice, the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.y6qA7KARTXADwzeV]{Cytheris Subsector} and the rest of the Macharian Sector would be lost.

16.en: The remaining Inquisitors of the Macharian Sector have carried on without an Inquisitor Lord ever since, free from Drake’s scrutiny. Though he commanded their respect, Drake was sometimes, in the eyes of his peers, far too conservative in his methods. The Inquisitors have been left to their own devices for too long, without coordination or cooperation, and mired in their increasingly radical methods without checks or balances.

20.en: But all that is about to change. Drake’s former Interrogator, now elevated to the position of Inquisitor herself, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} sees a great opportunity: to unite the Inquisitors of the sector in a series of Conclaves and coordinate their efforts against the sector’s most significant threats and eventually see a new Inquisitor Lord put in place. But can the other Inquisitors truly trust Horst in this endeavour? Is she simply invoking her mentor's name and towering reputation to elevate her position, or does she have an ulterior motive in mind?

24.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst}’s summons is the inciting incident behind the Heresies Macharia, a decades-spanning Inquisition campaign framework for

28.en: . A series of seven Conclaves, gathering the Inquisitors of the sector and their retinues together in one place, provides an opportunity to share leads and resources. Each Inquisitor has reasons to attend the Conclave and hear their fellows out. Some earnestly believe unity can be found; others believe that strife breeds strength or wish to keep an eye on their rivals.

32.en: Your characters and their Patron are attendees of these Conclaves, privy to the arguments and rumoured perils. Each Conclave influences the party’s subsequent missions, the trials and threats they face for the coming years, and the horrors they must conquer before the next Conclave. But heresy is everywhere, hidden across the sector, even in the dark corners of @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis}. Problems left unchecked anywhere fester into sector-threatening horrors. Each Inquisitor schemes to save the Imperium in their own distinct way, and their intense politicking within the Holy Orders often consumes those who participate in it.
